pipeline route readiness - Compute build readiness scores per route for a given month.

Usage: pipeline route readiness

Options:
  --db <db>               Local pipeline SQLite path
  --year <year>           Calendar year (default: 2026)
  --month <month>         Calendar month, 1-12 (default: 3)

Global Options:
  --help, -h
  --version
  --format <json|yaml|md|jsonl|csv>
  --json
  --full-output
  --schema
